translation_notes: Translation is direct: the literal g.query(TEXT) with an inline PREFIX becomes s{ } with the vg: prefix hoisted to a module-level @prefix, called with the explicit (spodgi) call suffix since spodgi is not the block's designated @graph.

The driver cannot execute either side: the region opens a real pangenome graph through the native spodgi.OdgiStore rdflib store plugin, a C++ extension over a binary .odgi file. Neither the spodgi package nor a genome dataset can be reproduced as a context shim without inventing the store's actual logic, so this is excluded per instructions section 6 item 1 (external/native dependency), confirmed by driver failure: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'spodgi'.
